name: Have you considered whether the service is part of the Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) or fundamental to the organisation's output and missions?
conditionsText:
Relevant whenever a service:
- Supports critical operations.
- Processes critical data.
- Provides essential services.
- Supports departmental missions.
- Could cause significant operational disruption if unavailable.
requirementTitle: Have you considered whether the service is part of the Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) or fundamental to the organisation's output and missions?
requirementDescription: Have you assessed how important the service is to government operations or national infrastructure?.. What happens if this service fails or is compromised?
why: Not all services have the same consequences if they fail, some may have a low impact some may have high impact.
tasks: Have you considered whether the service is part of the Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) or fundamental to the organisation's output an

actions.title: Have you considered whether the service is part of the Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) or fundamental to the organisation's output an
actions.description: You should assess Service Criticality, national impact and required resilience
